# @wildshard/sdk exports, by tier

<!-- generated by scripts/export-tiers.mjs from package.json exports and lint/export-tiers.json: do not edit -->

164 exports. A shard project imports from contract, rows, scripts and the bake kit; internal may change in any release. A new export needs a row in `lint/export-tiers.json` (`test/export-tiers.test.ts` fails without one); then run `node scripts/export-tiers.mjs`.
